issues.display_title: Issue #247: Investigate High Traffic at API Dev and API GO Dev
issues.main_description_html:
QA Investigation Summary — 21 August 2026

Tester: ekosy9
Environment: Dev (https://app2-dev.panorra.com)
Scope: High traffic investigation on API Dev and API GO Dev

Context

Screenshots in this issue show high CPU utilization on Proxmox containers hosting the dev API. This investigation evaluates the current API health, identifies public endpoints without rate limiting that may be contributing to the load, and documents baseline response times.

1. API Health Check

GET https://app2-dev.panorra.com/check-connection

Response 200:

{
  "services": {
    "centrifugo": "up",
    "database": "up",
    "elasticsearch": "up",
    "gothru_api": "down",
    "maps_api": "up",
    "minio": "up",
    "rabbitmq": "up",
    "rabbitmq_toronto": "up",
    "redis": "up",
    "smtp": "up"
  },
  "status": "ok"
}

⚠️ gothru_api is currently DOWN in the dev environment. All other services are operational.

2. Baseline Response Times

Endpoint Status Avg Response Time Rate Limited?
/ (root) 200 ~0.98s —
/check-connection 200 ~2.13s —
/users/forgot-password 400 (validation) ~0.97s ❌ No
/users/resend-otp 400 (validation) ~0.82s ❌ No
/register/user 400 (validation) ~0.79s ❌ No
/contact-us 400 (validation) ~0.95s ✅ Yes (5/min)
/users/check-otp 400 (validation) ~1.54s ❌ No

3. Rate Limiting Audit

Endpoint Auth Required Rate Limit Risk
/users/forgot-password ❌ Public ❌ None High — calls Google reCAPTCHA API per request
/users/resend-otp ❌ Public ❌ None High — calls Google reCAPTCHA API per request
/register/user ❌ Public ❌ None Medium
/register/validate ❌ Public ❌ None Low
/contact-us ✅ JWT Required ✅ 5 req/min per IP Protected
/auth ❌ Public ❌ None Medium

Rate limit verification on /contact-us:

Req 1–6: 400 (validation error)
Req 7:   429 Too Many Requests  ✅ rate limiter active

4. Concurrent Load Observation

10 parallel requests to /users/forgot-password:

All 10 requests processed simultaneously — no throttling applied
Response times: 1.91s – 1.95s per request

10 parallel requests to /users/resend-otp:

All 10 requests processed simultaneously — no throttling applied
Response times: 0.83s – 0.99s per request

Each request to /users/forgot-password triggers an outbound call to https://www.google.com/recaptcha/api/siteverify, adding ~1s latency per request. Under heavy concurrent traffic, this compounds into significant server load.

5. Observations

# Finding Severity
O-01 gothru_api is DOWN in dev — likely related to "API GO Dev" in the issue title High
O-02 /users/forgot-password has no rate limiting; each request calls Google reCAPTCHA API externally Medium
O-03 /users/resend-otp has no rate limiting; same external reCAPTCHA call pattern Medium
O-04 /register/user and /auth have no rate limiting Low
O-05 Baseline response times are elevated (0.8–2.1s) indicating existing server load Medium
O-06 /contact-us rate limiting is correctly enforced (429 on 6th+ request per minute) ✅ —

Notes

  • The screenshots show Proxmox container CPU graphs with sustained high utilization — consistent with high-volume concurrent requests to public endpoints
  • Without rate limiting, public endpoints (/users/forgot-password, /users/resend-otp) can be targeted repeatedly without any throttling defense
  • The external reCAPTCHA API calls on each request to these endpoints amplify the load effect
  • gothru_api being down may be a separate incident or a consequence of resource exhaustion from the high traffic

Investigation: COMPLETE — API remains functional. Key findings: gothru_api down, no rate limiting on high-risk public endpoints.

issues.display_title: Issue #261: Create View for User Report Users (Support)
issues.main_description_html:
Create a database view to aggregate user report data for Support User Report List API.

The view should include:

  • User information (fullname, username, email, created_at)
  • Last login from user_detail
  • Last reported timestamp (MAX updated_at from report_issue_user)
  • Total unreviewed reports (status = 0)

The view will be used to simplify query logic for:

  • Pagination
  • Searching by fullname, username, and email
  • Sorting by last reported date and total report count

QA Summary — 21 August 2026

Tester: ekosy9
Type: Code Review (read-only)
Scope: Create View for User Report Users (Support)

Review

This is a database-level task (CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW). No Go source file is required.

Check Result
SQL VIEW definition provided in developer comment ✅
View name: views_report_users ✅
Joins: users, user_detail, report_issue_user ✅
Filters: only reports with status = 0 (pending) ✅
Aggregates: MAX(r.updated_at) as last_reported, COUNT(r.id) as total_report ✅
Avatar field added (per developer update) ✅

SQL (from developer comment)
